'''Sanshi''' is an NPC in {{Location|Wenye Beach}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Sanshi:''' Hello, I am Thirty, a Patroller stationed in [[Dim Forest]]. You can always ask me about anything you want to know in Dim Forest.
:{{DIcon}} What's going on in Dim Forest?
:;(Before completing [[When the Forest is No Longer Dim]])
::'''Sanshi:''' The toxin spores are still drifting. You might find Frenzy [[Hoochief]] around here. Be on your alert when you travel!

:;(After completing When the Forest is No Longer Dim)
::'''Sanshi:''' The issues here are solved. I heard a powerful [[Resonator]] was of great help. How I want to meet {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* Sanshi refers to himself as "Thirty". This is due to his name in Chinese being directly translated: 三 (3), 十 (10).
